newsitem.title: USA: Parallel has stake in Gulf Coast well.
newsitem.headline: Parallel has stake in Gulf Coast well.

text.p: Parallel Petroleum Corp said it has a 19.3 percent working interest in a natural gas discovery well dually completed in two zones of the Frio Formation in Victoria County, Texas, onshore the Texas Gulf Coast.

The operator, privately held Mustang Fuel Corp, plans to produce the well at a stabilized rate of 2 million cubic feet of natural gas per day plus associated condensate. Mustang owns a 20 percent working interest in the well, and Parallel's working interest translates 13.9 percent net revenue interest, the company said.
